name: René Le Bègue
features: fair skin, dark hair neatly parted, dark eyes, youthful round face, slight build, boyish eager expression
bio: Won the 1937 Monte Carlo Rally in a Delahaye, the 1938 12 Hours of Paris with André Morel, and the 1939 Grand Prix du Comminges, and was third in the 1939 French Grand Prix. He and René Dreyfus took Talbot-Lagos to the 1940 Indianapolis 500, where he came home tenth. He survived the war with the Free French and then died at 32, asphyxiated by a faulty water heater as he was preparing to race again.
